'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Plumpang oil depot fire]]
**Seventeen people are killed and fifty others are injured in a fire at a fuel storage station in [[Koja, Jakarta]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/fire-breaks-out-indonesia-state-energy-company-pertaminas-fuel-storage-station-2023-03-03/ (Reuters)]
*Sixteen people are killed when a pipeline [[explode]]s in [[Emohua]], [[Rivers State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-oil-refinery-theft-explosion-c2bb9dbe398db7f802c3526c2440cf07 (AP)]
*One person is killed in [[Yazoo County, Mississippi]], [[United States]], and more than 310,000 people are [[power outage|left without power]] across five [[U.S. state|states]] due to a system of storms affecting the area. [https://www.wapt.com/article/strong-wind-gusts-cause-power-outages-in-areas-of-central-mississippi/43177315# (WAPT-TV)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/03/03/weather/winter-weather-us-south-tornado-storms-friday/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Phnom Penh]], [[Cambodia]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] opposition figure [[Kem Sokha]] to 27 years in prison on charges of "collusion with foreigners" and [[treason]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/mar/03/us-condemns-fabricated-case-as-cambodian-opposition-leader-is-jailed-for-27-years-treason-kem-sokha (''The Guardian'')]
*A court in [[Minsk]], [[Belarus]], sentences [[human rights]] activist and 2022 [[Nobel Peace Prize]] laureate [[Ales Bialiatski]] to 10 years in prison on charges of "financing actions violating public order" and [[smuggling]]. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-human-rights-bialiatski-2f6d9369dca22c243e8473c55211fdaa (AP)]
